attempts.summary: Repaired /srv/inventory permissions on node1: created service account inventorysvc and group inventory-readers, set recursive ownership to inventorysvc:inventory-readers with mode 750 (dirs) / 640 (files), preserving existing content (config.json, records.csv). Verified group-member read access works and outsider access is denied. Performed the mandatory single-node restart with boot_id proof and confirmed full recovery of ownership, permissions, and unchanged data checksums post-restart.
